question: Should OpenClaw permanently retain this metadata-only gateway restart ledger in shared state with the proposed fields, local access model, and fixed 512-row retention policy?
rationale: The implementation can prove bounded storage, redaction, and restart-path safety, but code review cannot choose the permanent privacy and operator-forensics contract on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve the bounded ledger
options.body: Accept the current metadata fields, recursive redaction, local shared-state access, and fixed 512-row retention as the internal restart-forensics contract.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Require removal or further normalization of selected actor, network, path, session, or preflight fields before approving durable storage.

options.title: Defer to unified auditing
options.body: Pause or close this PR and fold restart events into a separately approved general audit-ledger architecture with a canonical read contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded ledger
recommendation.body: Accept the current metadata fields, recursive redaction, local shared-state access, and fixed 512-row retention as the internal restart-forensics contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related metadata-only audit direction and explicitly distinguished this gateway-restart producer from the broader ledger proposal.
